name: tartinerlabs-mods
description: Claude Code mods — live panes, prompt bands, status line entries, toasts, and tool-call hooks

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: auto-session-name
plugins.description: Names each session from its first prompt, so it is easy to find in /resume.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A countdown to the prompt cache going cold, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: auto-resume
plugins.description: Sends "continue" once a usage limit resets, so a cut-off turn picks up where it stopped.

plugins.name: limit-watch
plugins.description: The 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, coloured by use, with reset countdowns and toasts at 80% and 95%.
